acceptance: Each of Q16/Q94/Q95 either runs on QuestDB and matches DuckDB on non-vacuous data (augmented second warehouse) or is a registered QuestDB skip with reason.
Corpus diff of changed QuestDB queries; fork CI questdb job green.
description:
Found while verifying the unpadded-date fix (#3501). QuestDB rejects the emitted TPC-DS Q16 and Q94 (correlated EXISTS: 'constant expected'; no HAVING) and likely Q95 (IN (subquery)), independent of dates. A hand-built join equivalent with the generator's date bounds matched DuckDB on 5 of 6 seed/query cases (Q95 seed 1001 ran out of QuestDB heap). No QuestDB TPC-DS bundle is published.
DECISION GATE: (G1) lower these constructs in the fork's QuestDB generator (decorrelate EXISTS/IN into joins, HAVING into a filtered subquery) with executed QuestDB tests, or register explicit QuestDB skips with reasons. Recommended: lowering if every rewrite is semantics-preserving and verified on QuestDB; otherwise registered skips.
GUARDRAILS: benchmark text unchanged; fork tests in the questdb CI job; no silent skips.
